guidance.heading: Financial Guidance
section: Our guidance takes into consideration the ongoing conflict in the Middle East and the inclusion of the Enhanced Drilling acquisition, which closed late July 2026. Additionally, we have updated our annual guidance based on third quarter and projected fourth quarter results.
